comment: The external programs this project runs, pinned by version and by the
SHA-256 their publisher states. tools/fetch-sidecars.ps1 fetches them.
Pinning a hash pins staleness as well as identity, and that is the
trade being made deliberately: a sidecar that silently became a
different program between two builds is worse than one that is a few
months old. Moving to a newer build is an edit to this file, which is
Both hashes below were read from the publisher's own checksum file,
not computed from whatever happened to download here.
`bytes` is the size of the download, stated so the app can say what a
fetch will cost before asking. It is not a check -- the hash is the
check -- and a publisher who re-cut the archive at the same version
would fail that long before this mattered.
